_comment: CDP coverage waiver ledger. Each entry excuses one stable protocol member from the `gap` count with an auditable, self-contained reason. `python3 -m runner.run coverage --check` requires this ledger to match runner.coverage.FROZEN_WAIVERS member-for-member. Additions or removals require updating the policy and frozen whitelist together; coverable members that merely lack a fixture remain gaps rather than waivers.

_categories.hardware: requires physical hardware / OS capability a headless engine cannot own
_categories.chrome_private: Chrome-internal behaviour with no cross-implementation contract
_categories.security_domain: security/permission surface not applicable to the bench sandbox
_categories.not_applicable: structurally out of the benchmark's protocol-observation scope

<Domain.method>.reason: concrete justification for excusing this member from coverage

Browser.close.reason: Closes the browser under test and tears down the very connection being observed; there is no in-session protocol observation of the effect.

Browser.addPrivacySandboxCoordinatorKeyC.reason: Privacy Sandbox coordinator-key plumbing internal to Chrome; no cross-implementation contract and no observable protocol effect for a native engine.

Browser.addPrivacySandboxEnrollmentOverr.reason: Privacy Sandbox enrollment override internal to Chrome; Chrome-only enrollment machinery with no cross-implementation semantics to conform to.

Debugger.setScriptSource.reason: Chrome rejects live source edits under a CDP connect/headless session ('setScriptSource functionality no longer available'), including file-backed scripts; the command is not exercisable in this harness (verified against Chrome 150).

Network.webTransportCreated.reason: Requires an HTTP/3 WebTransport server; the self-hosted fixture stack is HTTP/1.1 only, so no WebTransport session can be established.

Network.webTransportConnectionEstablishe.reason: Requires an HTTP/3 WebTransport server; not reachable from the HTTP/1.1 fixture stack.

Network.webTransportClosed.reason: Requires an HTTP/3 WebTransport session to first exist and then close; no WebTransport infra in the fixture stack.

Page.interstitialShown.reason: Fires only when Chrome renders a real security interstitial (e.g. a certificate error); not reproducible against the trusted local 127.0.0.1 fixture server.

Page.interstitialHidden.reason: Paired with interstitialShown; requires dismissing a security interstitial that the local fixture server never triggers.

Performance.metrics.reason: The Performance.metrics event is not emitted under a headless CDP connect session (only pushed to a live inspector timeline); the command surface is covered by Performance.getMetrics (v4_cdp_performance_disable).

Runtime.exceptionRevoked.reason: Fires when a previously reported exception is revoked; there is no deterministic, non-flaky trigger for revocation without a live inspector, so a stable Chrome-gated assertion is not achievable.

Runtime.inspectRequested.reason: Emitted only in response to a DevTools inspect() interaction; not reachable from a headless CDP driver.

Target.receivedMessageFromTarget.reason: Deprecated non-flatten-session artifact; the harness attaches with flatten=true (Target.attachToTarget), and flatten sessions route messages directly and never emit this event.

Target.targetCrashed.reason: Requires crashing a target (e.g. navigating to chrome://crash), which destabilizes the shared browser process for the remainder of the run.
